question: Showcasing its wildlife and religious sites at the 74th parade, which of the following states’ tableau won 1st prize at the 2023 Republic Day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Uttarakhand's tableau showcased the state's rich wildlife and prominent religious sites, capturing the essence of its natural beauty and cultural heritage.
 
• The tableau featured iconic elements such as the Corbett National Park, famous for its tiger reserve and diverse flora and fauna.
 
• It also highlighted significant religious sites like Kedarnath, which is one of the most revered pilgrimage destinations in India.
 
• The intricate design and vibrant representation of Uttarakhand's tableau earned it the first prize at the 2023 Republic Day parade.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Republic Day Parade**

 
 
• The Republic Day parade is an annual event held in New Delhi, India, to mark the adoption of the Constitution of India on January 26, 1950.
 
• The parade showcases India's cultural diversity, military prowess, and achievements in various fields.
 
• Various states present their tableaux during the parade, highlighting their unique cultural heritage, achievements, and important landmarks.
 
• The parade is attended by dignitaries, including the President of India, and is watched by millions of people across the country.
 
 
 
• **Jim Corbett National Park**
 
 
• Jim Corbett National Park is the oldest national park in India, established in 1936.
 
 
• **Kedarnath**
 
 
• Kedarnath is one of the holiest Hindu shrines dedicated to Lord Shiva, situated in the Garhwal Himalayas of Uttarakhand.
 
• The temple is part of the Char Dham pilgrimage circuit, which includes four sacred shrines in the Indian Himalayas.
 
• Kedarnath is located at an altitude of 3,583 meters and is known for its spiritual significance and breathtaking natural beauty.
 
• The temple attracts thousands of pilgrims every year, especially during the summer months when the shrine is accessible.
